bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Chicago Bears restructured contracts for Joe Thuney, Dayo Odeyingbo, and TJ Edwards, creating approximately $17 million in 2026 salary cap space, according to ESPN's Field Yates , fueling speculation that Chicago could still swing a trade for an edge rusher before the season. Chicago GM Ryan Poles is reportedly still looking for a "strong edge presence" to pair with Montez Sweat, with ESPN's Dan Graziano believing Poles could pursue a trade for such a player , even as names like Maxx Crosby and Josh Sweat continue to circulate as potential targets.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: Running back Jahmyr Gibbs was named the headliner of a group of six Detroit Lions players voted into the 2026 NFL Top 100, reflecting the roster's continued high-level talent heading into the season. Meanwhile, the Lions have been busy finalizing their roster after cuts, including placing RB Isiah Pacheco on injured reserve, adding depth pieces to the practice squad, and reportedly re-signing TE Tyler Conklin as they prepare for the season opener against the Colts.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Green Bay Packers are dealing with running back Josh Jacobs' status after he was placed on the Commissioner's Exempt List , with reports noting his initial appearance for the Packers running back moved up to Sept. 10 as the team prepares for its Week 1 matchup against the Vikings.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The biggest Minnesota Vikings story from the past day centers on safety Harrison Smith officially returning to the team for his 15th NFL season. The Vikings agreed to terms on a one-year contract with safety Harrison Smith, bringing the six-time Pro Bowler back for a 15th NFL season, with the agreement carrying a $12.25 million base value and incentives that can push the maximum value to $16.25 million.
